requirement: A turn that wrote the site is looked at before it closes: the page the customer had open is drawn again and compared with the picture from before the turn; only a confident not_shown or broken, with both pictures of the same page, steers one notice; every other outcome is skipped with its reason and makes no claim

oracle.invariant: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. A confident not_shown or broken steers exactly one notice whose source producer is tracy-site-tools:visual-check, with the page now as an image only when the session model reads images; shown, cannot_tell, an unreadable answer and shadow mode steer nothing; no write, no before picture, a before or after page not loaded, a comment pinned on another page, no image model, a capture failure or one past the budget, no image store, and a thrown error are each skipped with their reason. Through the shipped lib/index.js: a page drawn while the customer writes, then a writing turn that stops, is drawn again in the same window, compared once, and steered once; the step the notice adds is not checked again; shadow, off, viewContext off and a turn that wrote nothing steer nothing; a failing model never throws into the turn. Every command exits 0.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: visualCheckMode: on unless false or shadow
pageOf: one page per address — trailing slash, fragment and origin do not make another
commentPage: the page a comment turn was pinned on, read with the chat input’s own parser
turnWrites: only the calls of the last turn that changed the site
parseVerdict: the one JSON object, or nothing; a failure that points at nothing is cannot_tell
judgeMessage: both pictures, each named, and the reply given as a claim
checkNotice: a guess said as one, read before writing, honest even after "done"
🔒 a confident "does not show" steers ONE notice from this plugin, with the page now when the agent sees pictures

🔒 no claim without both pictures of the right page, a write, a model or a picture now

🔒 never throws: a capture that throws is a skipped check
